lines.en: Awoken by the sound of my phone, I fight back against the desire to keep my eyes closed and continue my dream.
You see, as “wonderful” as those have been lately, I’ve developed a bit of an issue when it comes to staying trapped inside of them for too long.
And what I mean by this is rather personal — but seeing as you’ve watched me penetrate countless teens by now, I suppose that you knowing one more intimate detail isn’t the end of the world.
You see, I’ve become so invested and immersed in my dreams lately, that I’ve been cumming in my sleep.
It’s particularly obnoxious on nights where it happens early on as it gives the cum time to dry and creates an extremely unpleasant sensation that never ceases to shock and surprise me.
But I suck it up (not literally of course) because the things I’ve been experiencing in the world where she exists are far better than anything I’ve experienced here.
I had sex with the God of Torment last night.
And the reason I’ve decided to wake up is not just because I wanted to save myself a morning-shower, but because I feared for my dream-penis and what her scissor wings would do to it.
: Hello?
: Oh! Good morning, Akira. I’m not calling too early, am I?
: Why are you calling at all?
: Oh my. Judging by that attitude, perhaps it is too early after all. Would you prefer if I called back at a later time?
: I didn’t mean to give you an attitude. I’m just not sure why you couldn’t wait until-
I take a look at the clock to find it’s even earlier than I thought.
: Tsubasa, it’s only 6:30.
: Well, what time do people in your tax bracket typically get themselves out of bed?
: Any day where I have to get out of bed before 7:00 winds up being terrible. But hey, every day has been terrible lately. So I guess I’ll just...go get the worm or something.
: The worm?
: You know...like...the early bird gets the worm.
: I’m confused. You own a bird?
: Never mind. Just tell me what you want.
: What kind of bird is it?
: Tsubasa, I don’t have a bird.
: Why, it’s very impolite to trick people over the phone, Akira. You should know by now how gullible and easy to deceive I am.
: You? No. Touka, maybe. But I refuse to believe you’re not aware of everything ever at all times.
: Hahah! Stop, stop. You give me too much credit, Akira.
: Why do you keep saying my name?
: Well, because it’s a beautiful name, of course! Akira. I’m sure you don’t mind me using your given name, correct? We are friends after all, aren’t we?
: Is that what we are?
: I believe so. Unless you’re looking to get something else out of this relationship.
: Sorry, are you flirting with me right now? Is this a booty call?
: Oh, I’ve heard of those in pop culture! That’s when two people arrange a meet-up with the intention of having sexual intercourse, correct?
: Uhh...yeah. Yeah, that’s what that means.
: Hilarious! But no, that’s not what this is. And I can’t quite tell if I’m flattered or offended that you’d assume such a thing.
: I would like to see you, though.
: For purposes unrelated to sex as I’m a faithful  albeit extremely unsatisfied
: You got quiet in the middle of that last-
: I’m afraid I don’t know what you’re talking about. Regardless, are you free right now? I’ve opened up a slot in anticipation of your arrival.
: Now? I have to check on my niece first.
: Ahh...yes. I’ve heard from Touka that things seem rather...complicated in that regard. But don’t worry. You may take your time.
: And whenever you’re ready, there will be a car outside of your house.
: Like...Like it’s there right now?
: Yes. But it’s fine to keep them waiting. They’re very well-trained and understand that commoners don’t prioritize punctuality the way my family does.
: Tsubasa, I didn’t even know we were meeting until a few minutes ago. I don’t think punctuality matters here.
: Akira, while I do love the sound of your voice, I do hope you know that every second you spend talking to me is one second between you and your beloved Ami. And then subsequently me again.
: Can I at least know what you want to talk about so I can prime myself for another uncomfortable discussion with a woman who could have me killed at any moment?
: Hahah! No, actually. I quite like the idea of keeping you on edge.
: Tsubasa-
: Ciao!
I hang up the phone and...accept that this is happening again.

But even though Tsubasa’s affinity for keeping me on my toes is shining brighter than ever, I do have to note that she hasn’t yet blinded me in any capacity. So maybe this...instinctual distrust is wrong.
She is on my side, right?
And if she trusts me enough to be alone with her daughters, then-
THEN SHE IS A FOOLISH BITCH IN NEED OF SOME THICK COCK.
: Thank you very much for coming, Akira. Please allow me to extend my sincerest apologies in regard to tearing you away from your niece.
: It’s fine. She can be alone for a little while.
: Forgive me for asking, but would you mind sharing exactly what’s wrong with her? Because, if there’s something I could do-
: Can you bring the dead back to life?
: That was a joke.
: Oh, good. I couldn’t quite tell.
: Yeah. But Tsubasa, before you talk about whatever you’re going to talk about, I want to make something extremely clear to you.
: Please do.
: Do not, under any circumstances, get yourself involved with my niece.
: I get that you’re a curious woman who wants to use her powers for good or whatever it was that pushed you into uprooting Chika’s entire life and planting your daughter in my class.
: But this is different. This is my family. And I will not let you get involved with Ami.
: Forgive me for being blunt here- but who do you think you are, speaking to me that way?
: I’m not kidding. This-
: Hahah! Forgive me! I just couldn’t help but try to sound threatening there.
: I can assure you that if you do not want me to get involved, that I will keep my nose out of it. I know a thing or two about the situation and can acknowledge how sticky it must be.
: I’m...not surprised to hear you know “a thing or two.” But...thanks.
: Were you scared, though? Of my “don’t talk to me like that” voice? Did I sound intimidating?
: You pretty much always sound intimidating.
: How was I, though? I don’t get all serious that often so I have no idea how it must have sounded.
: I quite liked it, actually. It isn’t every day that someone speaks to me like that.
: But I suppose our time would be better spent discussing matters apart from the things we like about one another. After all, you never know when my husband might be listening in.
: And I can’t imagine he’s the type of person you want to make jealous. Right, Akira?
: The reason I called you is simple, really. And it’s a call you’d be right to expect at...somewhat regular intervals in the future.
: I understand that you’ve decided to take a leave of absence from your job as a teacher, correct?
: Yeah, but...if this is about me going back-
: It’s nothing of the sort. I’d never force you to do anything, even if it does seem as if I’m pushing you in certain directions from time to time.
: I know. Because you’re the type who will manipulate me into thinking that I’m making my own decisions instead. When, in all actuality, you’re the one pulling my strings.
: Ooooh...you’re feisty today.
: Only because I know you like being talked down to now.
: Don’t push it, though. You’re not quite sure what my limits are yet, Akira.
: You’re right. So please, do me the favor of telling me what you’re going to manipulate me into doing this time so I can go back home and take a nap.
: Status reports.
: Status reports?
: On all four of my daughters since the Chosokabe girls are under my wing now as well.

: Can’t you just...ask them yourself? There’s no sense in hearing about their education from me when A) I’m no longer a teacher. And B) I could just lie and make myself sound better than I actually am.
: It’s not their education I’m interested in, Akira. I can evaluate that myself. And frankly, I imagine I’m more adept at such a thing than you to begin with.
: What I want is your opinion on the type of women they’re becoming. If they’re sticking to the right path or-
: If they’re following me down the one I’m on...
: Now, now, Akira. There’s no need to belittle yourself like that.
: I’m just not sure what else you could mean. Without beating around the bush, we both know you’re smart enough to realize that nothing good will come from any of them being around me.
: Again, you seem to misunderstand the way I view your relationships with all of my girls. So I’ll remind you now that my moral code is somewhat askew as well due to my background.
: Is this the part where you slap a bell around your daughter’s neck and see how much I’m willing to bid for her?

: The wealthiest among us are typically the most frugal, Akira. As such, there’s no need for a bell at all. Touka’s already grazing in your pasture and you’ll always be able to find her there if you just step outside.
: I’m...out of cow-based knowledge and unsure of how to proceed with this dialogue.
: Then I’ll ask you plain and simple.
Tsubasa moves further down an aisle lined with marble and satin and emphasizes the distance between us in every sense of the word.
And even though I know I’ll never catch her, I can’t help but chase her down.
She turns to face me. And despite her inarguable beauty and the passing thought that simply touching her would be akin to fucking the God of Torment once more, I feel stuck.
I want to reach out and feel her, but I’m content with the space between us and the way the sunlight reflects off of the manor’s tiled floors. And I don’t want to ruin it.
I want to stay here forever, dangling from the strings she holds above my head because I know she can choose better for me than I ever could.
I’ll just never understand why my strings were the ones she reached for.
: Touka’s seemed a bit...different lately. Would you agree with that, Akira?
: I...haven’t seen her much. I’ve been unconscious for two months, remember?
: Right, right. And, within that time, she grew rather...grumpy, to say the least. Why, she’s even raised her voice at me a few times. It was quite shocking.
: Where do you think that attitude comes from, Akira?
: My eldest daughter truly has fallen head over heels for you, hasn't she?
: Nothing’s happened between us, Tsubasa.
: Yes, but is that your choosing or hers?
: I don’t...see her that way.
: Nonsense. Every man in Kumon-mi would jump at the chance to bed my daughter regardless of her age. Denying your own feelings on the matter would actually be quite offensive.
: I mean...yeah. She’s hot. But I’ve found...something else in her.
: Something else?
: Something...I don’t know. It’s going to sound stupid.
: No, I’m intrigued. Do tell.
: Something...comforting.
: Comforting...
: As in...matriarchal?
: Yeah...That.
: Hah...I see.
: Does that...disappoint you?
: It doesn’t disappoint me. And I can understand where you’re coming from. I’m just surprised to see a man your age admit it. Isn’t your type typically a bit more...proud?
: Probably. But I’ve reached a point where everything hurts so much that I find little purpose in continuing to hide feelings like that.
: How do you think Touka would feel if she heard you say such a thing?
: Sad. Angry. Compassionate? I don’t know. Touka’s a lot of things and literally all of them are good.
: And Tsukasa?
: What about her?
: You had your first session with her the other day, didn’t you? Tutoring.
: Not intentionally. She kind of just showed up and then everything went to shit.
: Hah...I was worried about that.

: In fact, I didn’t even know you two had run into one another until Chika informed me. And when I confronted Tsukasa about it, she was unwilling to say anything at all. Likely out of shame, I imagine.
: No, Tsukasa didn’t do anything wrong. I was just...not in the right frame of mind that day. It wasn’t her fault.
: Is...Is that so? You’re not just saying that to keep her out of trouble?
: No. Tsukasa...
: Forgive me for saying this, but Tsukasa’s a brat.
: Oh, I’m well aware.
: But she’s very smart. And I can tell she’s been raised well.
: And if I was in the position to be tutoring again, she’d be great. She seems willing to learn and...and easy to teach so long as she doesn’t fire me for looking at her wrong.
: And the reason you’re not in the “position” to tutor is because of your...mental health?
: Right.
: As in...you believe it would be dangerous for my daughter to be in your care? Or you believe you would be in danger due to caring for my daughter?
: Both?...
: I see.
: I must have scared you when we first spoke about this in my office.
: Yeah, well...
: Not as much as I scare myself sometimes.
: Are...you thinking about something?
: A few things. But each one seems rather...destructive?
: That’s...not a good word.
: The gist is that I’m not sure how I’m supposed to look at you now.
: Meaning?
: Meaning that it sounds rather fishy to hear you talk about not wanting to bed my eldest daughter, but not trusting yourself around my youngest.
: Can we just...not talk about this anymore?
: I think we have to now, don’t we?
: We definitely don’t. And I should probably head home before-
: Akira.
: What?
: Oh, nothing.
: I just wanted to say your name again.
: Akira, Akira, Akira...What an interesting man you are.
: I wonder how you got here? Apart from the limo, I mean.
: It’s probably better if we avoid that topic too.
: Oh?
: It’s just...bringing up the past isn’t exactly one of my fondest hobbies. And it doesn’t help that most of it is still pretty hazy.
: Yes...age will do that to us, won’t it?
: And misery.
: Are you unhappy, Akira?
: I don’t know how much longer I can do this, Tsubasa.
: Mm.
: I’m glad you’re happy, though. You have an amazing life and two amazing daughters.
: Do you think having such things is enough to make a person happy?
: Is it not?
: Sometimes I wonder.
: It takes more than just having things to make life worth living. But I guess we can leave it at that as I don’t want to make you feel any worse than I’m sure you already do.
: Then...I guess this concludes our status report?
: I guess so.
: Please hand me your cell phone.
: What?
: Immediately.
: Or I will have it seized by security.
: I don’t-
: Now, please.
: I don’t have all day.
: Tsubasa-
: Yoink.
: What?...
: Why are you-
: Shh...
: Everything will be over soon.
: Oooh. Cute wallpaper.
: You must really love your niece.
: What are you doing?...
: Calling the police, of course.
: I left my phone in the other room. And you’ve said some very suspicious things in regard to my darling Tsukasa that I’m not willing to ignore.
: But...nothing’s happened...
: Then you won’t mind your house being searched.
: Tsubasa-
: I’m kidding.
: Here.
Tsubasa hands the phone back to me and-
You have obtained Tsukasa’s phone number!
: Who knows? Maybe I’m a bad person after all?
: What’s wrong? Cat got your tongue?
: I just...I’m so confused...
: Me too. We’ll see if I regret this later.
: I read in a self-help book recently that doing impulsive things like this can lead to an increase in serotonin. Maybe this was a bit too impulsive, though?
: You think?
: Well, look at it this way — you’ve been hanging around Chinami for how long now? And you’ve never done anything impure to her, have you?
: Well...no. But-
: Then there’s clearly a part of you that knows how wrong it is and that part of you is winning. Just look at this as a...test.
: This isn’t a test I want to take, Tsubasa.
: We all have to do things we don’t want sometimes, Akira.
: You don’t. Touka doesn’t. Tsukasa doesn’t.
: All I’m hearing is that your life would be smooth sailing if you married one of my daughters and joined the family. And look, I’ve now made it easier than ever for you to do that.
: You’re putting way too much trust in me.
: Who says I’m putting any trust in you at all? Maybe I’m just...cutting off a few of your strings so you don’t confuse yourself as my puppet anymore.
: Aaaaanyway, I need to review some recent acquisitions before a call this afternoon. But you’re free to continue exploring the grounds if you like.
: There’s a good chance you might find Touka in the pool. But I’m worried her poor, maidenly heart wouldn’t be able to take another instance of her beloved Sensei seeing her as a matriarch.
: Until next time, Akira.
: I’m hoping for a very interesting status report.
I leave the manor.
I turn my phone off.
Tsubasa’s affection has increased to [tsubasa_love]!
